scenarios.title: A｜普通提醒
scenarios.setting: 玩家发现自己的吹风机又被室友拿走，用完后放在了客厅。

turns.prompt: 你想确认室友是否用过自己的物品，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hey, did you use my hair dryer?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, did you use my hair dryer?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: I think you left my hair dryer in the living room. Did you use it?

feedback.naturalExpression: I think you left my hair dryer in the living room. Did you use it?
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Hey, I noticed my hair dryer wasn’t where I left it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, I noticed my hair dryer wasn’t where I left it.
feedback.explanation: “I noticed”把话题建立在自己观察到的现象上，适合开始说明问题。

choices.text: Have you been using my hair dryer?

feedback.naturalExpression: Have you been using my hair dryer?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: Did you used my hair dryer?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, did you use my hair dryer?
feedback.explanation: 问句已有“did”，后面用动词原形“use”，不再用过去式“used”。

turns.text: Oh, yeah. Sorry. Mine stopped working, so I borrowed yours.

turns.prompt: 你想提醒室友用完后归还物品，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. Could you put it back when you’re done with it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Could you put it back when you’re done with it?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: That’s fine. Just remember to return it afterward.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine. Just remember to return it afterward.
feedback.explanation: 明确表示接受刚提出的方案，让对方知道可以按这个安排继续。

choices.text: No problem this time. I was just looking for it earlier.

feedback.naturalExpression: No problem this time. I was just looking for it earlier.
feedback.explanation: “looking for”表示正在寻找，区别于强调找到结果的“find”。

choices.text: I’d appreciate it if you put my stuff back where you found it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d appreciate it if you put my stuff back where you found it.
feedback.explanation: “I’d appreciate”将希望对方做的事与感谢联系起来，语气比直接命令更委婉。

turns.prompt: 你想让对方放轻松，表示理解或不介意，会怎么说？

choices.text: No worries. Thanks.

feedback.naturalExpression: No worries. Thanks.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: It’s okay. Just keep it in mind next time.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s okay. Just keep it in mind next time.
feedback.explanation: “next time”把可能的参与留到下次，适合婉拒当下的邀请。

scenarios.title: B｜要求先询问
scenarios.setting: 室友已经不止一次直接拿玩家的私人物品。

turns.prompt: 你想说明借用物品前应先征得同意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you ask me before you use my stuff next time?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you ask me before you use my stuff next time?
feedback.explanation: “next time”把可能的参与留到下次，适合婉拒当下的邀请。

choices.text: I don’t mind lending you things, but I’d like you to ask first.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t mind lending you things, but I’d like you to ask first.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Please check with me before borrowing something that belongs to me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Please check with me before borrowing something that belongs to me.
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

choices.text: I’m happy to share some things, but I don’t want you to assume everything is okay to use.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m happy to share some things, but I don’t want you to assume everything is okay to use.
feedback.explanation: “I'm happy”表达自己的积极感受，适合回应好消息或说明一件事对自己的意义。

turns.text: I didn’t think you’d care. We share stuff all the time.

turns.prompt: 你想说明借用物品前先询问的重要性，会怎么说？

choices.text: Some things are fine to share, but I’d still rather you ask.

feedback.naturalExpression: Some things are fine to share, but I’d still rather you ask.
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: I know, but there are some things I’d prefer to keep personal.

feedback.naturalExpression: I know, but there are some things I’d prefer to keep personal.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: It’s not a huge deal. I just want to know before someone uses my things.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s not a huge deal. I just want to know before someone uses my things.
feedback.explanation: “I just want”强调自己真正希望解决的事，能把讨论拉回具体诉求。

choices.text: I’m not saying you can never borrow anything. Just ask me first.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not saying you can never borrow anything. Just ask me first.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

turns.prompt: 你已经了解所需信息，想表达感谢并结束交流，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks. That’s all I’m asking.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. That’s all I’m asking.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Great. And obviously you can expect the same from me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. And obviously you can expect the same from me.
feedback.explanation: 先回应对方刚给的信息或建议，再接着说明自己的想法，让话题顺着当前内容继续。

scenarios.title: C｜东西被弄坏
scenarios.setting: 玩家发现自己的吹风机坏了，而室友前一天刚刚借过。

turns.prompt: 你想询问室友是否了解物品损坏的经过，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hey, something happened to my hair dryer. Do you know anything about it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, something happened to my hair dryer. Do you know anything about it?
feedback.explanation: 询问对方是否掌握所需信息，也给“不清楚”留出回答空间。

choices.text: My hair dryer isn’t working anymore. Did something happen when you used it?

feedback.naturalExpression: My hair dryer isn’t working anymore. Did something happen when you used it?
feedback.explanation: “did something happen”先询问是否有事情发生，避免直接把计划变化归结为对方故意不配合。

choices.text: I noticed this is broken, and I know you used it yesterday. What happened?

feedback.naturalExpression: I noticed this is broken, and I know you used it yesterday. What happened?
feedback.explanation: “I noticed”把话题建立在自己观察到的现象上，适合开始说明问题。

choices.text: Can you tell me honestly if something happened to it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can you tell me honestly if something happened to it?
feedback.explanation: “Can you …?”直接请对方帮忙，是常见口语请求；使用“can”本身并不等于不礼貌。

turns.text: It stopped working while I was using it. I thought maybe it was already broken.

turns.prompt: 你想补充物品借出前的状态，会怎么说？

choices.text: It was working fine before you borrowed it.

feedback.naturalExpression: It was working fine before you borrowed it.
feedback.explanation: 对照借出前后的状态，说明为什么需要讨论损坏问题，同时避免猜测具体原因。

choices.text: If it broke while you were using it, I wish you’d told me.

feedback.naturalExpression: If it broke while you were using it, I wish you’d told me.
feedback.explanation: “If”保留损坏经过尚待核实的前提，再说明自己希望发生问题时被及时告知。

choices.text: Even if it was an accident, you should’ve let me know.

feedback.naturalExpression: Even if it was an accident, you should’ve let me know.
feedback.explanation: “should’ve”谈过去时可表示本该这样做，适合反思或承认疏忽。

choices.text: I’m more bothered that you didn’t tell me than by the fact that it broke.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m more bothered that you didn’t tell me than by the fact that it broke.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

turns.text: I’m sorry. I should’ve said something.

turns.prompt: 你想商量损坏物品的补偿或更换，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you replace it, or at least help pay for a new one?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you replace it, or at least help pay for a new one?
feedback.explanation: “at least”表示最低数量或程度，能说明可接受的下限。

choices.text: I think it’s fair for you to replace it since it broke while you were using it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think it’s fair for you to replace it since it broke while you were using it.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Can we split the cost of a replacement?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can we split the cost of a replacement?
feedback.explanation: “a replacement”指替换品，区别于直接退款或继续等待维修。

choices.text: Thanks for admitting it. Let’s figure out what to do about replacing it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for admitting it. Let’s figure out what to do about replacing it.
feedback.explanation: “figure out”表示想明白或弄清楚，强调经过思考找到办法。

turns.text: Yeah. I’ll buy you a new one.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. Thanks, I appreciate that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Thanks, I appreciate that.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

choices.text: Thanks. And please just tell me right away if something like this happens again.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. And please just tell me right away if something like this happens again.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。
